zh.text: $SPY - RBC 認為標普 500 指數在未來 12 個月將上漲 16.5% 至 8,050。RBC Capital Markets 策略師 Lori Calvasina 預測標普 500 將達到 8,050，意味著從週五收盤價上漲 16.5%。RBC 引用看空投資者情緒、彈性經濟增長和強勁企業盈利作為主要驅動因素，儘管近期市場調整了 11.6%。該公司預期估值將在 2027 年底壓縮至 18.8 倍過去盈利。最大風險：激進的聯儲加息和國債收益率超過 6%。RBC 偏好價值股而非成長股，小型股而非大型股，並維持對金融和醫療保健的超配。該公司警告稱確定性的市場底部尚未得到確認。

en.text: $SPY - RBC sees S&P 500 rising 16.5% to 8,050 over next 12 months. RBC Capital Markets strategist Lori Calvasina forecasts the S&P 500 reaching 8,050, implying 16.5% upside from Friday's close. RBC cites bearish investor sentiment, resilient economic growth and strong corporate earnings as key drivers despite the recent 11.6% market correction. The firm expects valuations to compress to 18.8x trailing earnings by late 2027. Biggest risk: Aggressive Fed rate hikes and Treasury yields exceeding 6%. RBC favors value stocks over growth, small caps over large caps, and remains overweight financials and healthcare. The firm cautions that a definitive market bottom has not yet been confirmed.
